_about: A simulated AWS Organization for lab M29. Every account ID, key string and IP address is a fake lab placeholder. IPs are from the RFC 5737 documentation ranges (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24).

register._about: The approved-AI register: what the security team knows about and has signed off. Anything the hunt finds that is not here is shadow AI.

decoys.note: LAB PLACEHOLDER. In a real account this would be an IAM user with no permissions at all. Any use is an alert.
LAB PLACEHOLDER for a long-term Bedrock API key. The key itself is never logged by CloudTrail, so a rule must match the IAM user behind it (challenge 2).

app_principals.note: The helpdesk batch job. It reaches Bedrock only through the interface endpoint, so a call without vpcEndpointId came from somewhere else.

assumptions._about: Lab assumptions, NOT AWS figures. CloudTrail documents an average of about 5 minutes for delivery to S3 and no figure for EventBridge. Measure your own (lesson 29.7, guided build).
